# Toolbar

> Roving-focus toolbar for editor controls and compact actions.

This file matches the installed `toolbar` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/toolbar.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/toolbar.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/toolbar-knobs`: `toolbarKnobs`, types `ToolbarKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/toolbar`: `Toolbar`, `ToolbarButton`, `ToolbarLink`, `ToolbarGroup`, `ToolbarSeparator`, `ToolbarInput`, types `ToolbarVariant`, `ToolbarChrome`, `ToolbarLinkVariant`, `ToolbarProps`, `ToolbarButtonProps`, `ToolbarLinkProps`, `ToolbarGroupProps`, `ToolbarSeparatorProps`, `ToolbarInputProps`

## Composition

### Editing controls

```tsx
<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarGroup>
    <ToolbarButton />
    <ToolbarLink />
  </ToolbarGroup>
  <ToolbarSeparator />
  <ToolbarInput />
</Toolbar>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { AlignCenterIcon, AlignLeftIcon, AlignRightIcon, BoldIcon, ItalicIcon, UnderlineIcon } from "lucide-react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useState } from "react";

import { Toolbar, ToolbarButton, ToolbarGroup, ToolbarSeparator } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/toolbar";

type Mark = "bold" | "italic" | "underline";
type Alignment = "left" | "center" | "right";

const MARKS: readonly { mark: Mark; label: string; icon: ReactNode }[] = [
  { mark: "bold", label: "Bold", icon: <BoldIcon /> },
  { mark: "italic", label: "Italic", icon: <ItalicIcon /> },
  { mark: "underline", label: "Underline", icon: <UnderlineIcon /> },
];

const ALIGNMENTS: readonly { alignment: Alignment; label: string; icon: ReactNode }[] = [
  { alignment: "left", label: "Align left", icon: <AlignLeftIcon /> },
  { alignment: "center", label: "Align center", icon: <AlignCenterIcon /> },
  { alignment: "right", label: "Align right", icon: <AlignRightIcon /> },
];

export function PrimitiveToolbarExample() {
  const [marks, setMarks] = useState<Record<Mark, boolean>>({ bold: true, italic: false, underline: false });
  const [alignment, setAlignment] = useState<Alignment>("left");

  return (
    <Toolbar aria-label="Text formatting">
      <ToolbarGroup aria-label="Text style">
        {MARKS.map((entry) => (
          <ToolbarButton
            key={entry.mark}
            aria-label={entry.label}
            iconOnly
            aria-pressed={marks[entry.mark]}
            onClick={() => setMarks((current) => ({ ...current, [entry.mark]: !current[entry.mark] }))}
          >
            {entry.icon}
          </ToolbarButton>
        ))}
      </ToolbarGroup>

      <ToolbarSeparator />

      <ToolbarGroup aria-label="Alignment">
        {ALIGNMENTS.map((entry) => (
          <ToolbarButton
            key={entry.alignment}
            aria-label={entry.label}
            iconOnly
            aria-pressed={alignment === entry.alignment}
            onClick={() => setAlignment(entry.alignment)}
          >
            {entry.icon}
          </ToolbarButton>
        ))}
      </ToolbarGroup>

      <ToolbarSeparator />

      <ToolbarButton onClick={() => setMarks({ bold: false, italic: false, underline: false })}>Clear</ToolbarButton>
    </Toolbar>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `toolbar`
  - `button`: `data-disabled`, `data-focusable`, `data-icon-only`, `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-size` (`sm`)
  - `group`: `data-disabled`, `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`)
  - `input`: `data-disabled`, `data-focusable`, `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-size` (`sm`)
  - `link`: `data-active`, `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-size` (`sm`), `data-variant` (`default` | `track`)
  - `root`: `data-chrome` (`embedded` | `standalone`), `data-disabled`, `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-variant` (`default` | `floating` | `inverse`)
  - `separator`: `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`)
  - `surface`: `data-popup-kind` (`toolbar`), `data-popup-static`

- `--cui-toolbar-radius`: `calc(
      min(var(--cui-toolbar-item-radius), calc(var(--control-h-sm) / 2)) +

        calc(var(--cui-toolbar-padding) + var(--cui-toolbar-border-width))
